q1_issues.issue: Location (and likewise Time and Past) is attached to sk_group_1, which is a GroupOf sum individual rather than an eventuality, and 'never Location on an entity' bars that head there.
No event witness and no per-member rule are emitted, so nothing states that the individual accidents occurred on that road — only that a group of them is somehow located there.

q2_gaps: plural event-nouns under a light verb ('many accidents have occurred') — the light-verb rule removes the event witness while the plural/group machinery expects a group event plus a per-member distribution rule for a distributive predicate, and the interaction of the two is unspecified

'many' as an episodic count phrase — it is absent from the CardinalityPhrase vague-quantity list ('a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds / a lot of'), while the proportion-word table that does list it covers generic readings only
notes: The traffic_accident compound is decomposed correctly (genus emitted, noun modifier left unexposed), and 'recently' is correctly a bare deictic Time constant.
